summary: ROW_NUMBER assigns a sequence based on its window order.
introduction: ROW_NUMBER assigns a sequence based on its window order. Your task: Reverse the page order and predict the numbers.

Explain the example for number a sorted result

blocks.text: ROW_NUMBER assigns a sequence based on its window order. The original rows remain separate.
Use SQL Server 2019+ in a separate practice database with a SQL editor. T-SQL is different from the SQLite engine on this site, so these examples are for that separate tool.

blocks.title: Number a sorted result

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ORDER BY` chooses a result order. Include a tie-break field when equal values need a stable order.
`ROW_NUMBER` numbers rows according to its window order while keeping those rows separate.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: Tiny Seed is numbered 1, and Moon Trip is numbered 2.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use enough ordering fields to break ties if a stable numbering is needed.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Reverse the page order and predict the numbers.
